scope: Full4834-frame Dev, not Test. All registered rows and failures retained. Cached replay speed excludes pixel/encoder preparation and is not end-to-end FPS.
note: Complete12 epoch18 clean-only matched loss-removal controls. Encoder/data/thresholds preserved.

config.registration: Registered before two-observation consensus replay. Preserve complete RGB memory first. A complementary old-ID link must improve the corresponding RGB query for two distinct past observations separated by>=2 frames, both within8 frames of current input. No anchor means abstain. Same encoder/head and thresholds as ordered control; clean-only heads provide the loss-removal controls. No Test selection.
